mode.zh-CN: 展示模式：popup 是底部无遮罩的非模态面板（SideSheet），modal 是模态对话框（Modal）。未声明的属性按模式落到对应的 SideSheet 或 Modal 上。
mode.en-US: Display mode: popup is a non-modal panel at the bottom without a mask (SideSheet); modal is a modal dialog (Modal). Attributes Feedback does not declare go to the SideSheet or Modal of the current mode.

type.zh-CN: 反馈内容的类型。custom 时内容写在默认插槽中。
type.en-US: Type of the feedback content. For custom, the content goes in the default slot.

visible.zh-CN: 是否显示，配合 v-model:visible 使用。
visible.en-US: Whether the feedback is shown. Use it with v-model:visible.

title.zh-CN: 纯文本标题，同时作为对话框的可访问名称；同时给出 title 插槽时以插槽为准。
title.en-US: Plain-text title that also names the dialog. The title slot wins when both are given.

textAreaProps.zh-CN: type 为 text 与 emoji 时多行输入框的属性，不含 modelValue（值由 Feedback 管理）；其中的 onChange 在 Feedback 处理后调用。
textAreaProps.en-US: Props of the multi-line input for the text and emoji types, without modelValue (Feedback owns the value); its onChange is called after Feedback handles the change.

radioGroupProps.zh-CN: type 为 radio 时单选组的属性，写法同 RadioGroup 的属性。选项组默认没有可访问名称，请用 aria-label 命名。
radioGroupProps.en-US: Props of the radio group for the radio type, written as the props of RadioGroup. The group has no accessible name by default; name it with aria-label.

checkboxGroupProps.zh-CN: type 为 checkbox 时多选组的属性，写法同 CheckboxGroup 的属性。选项组默认没有可访问名称，请用 aria-label 命名。
checkboxGroupProps.en-US: Props of the checkbox group for the checkbox type, written as the props of CheckboxGroup. The group has no accessible name by default; name it with aria-label.

okButtonProps.zh-CN: 提交按钮的属性。未给 disabled 时按值禁用（值为空时禁用），给出后以使用方的值为准，type 为 custom 时用它控制提交；loading 取内置的挂起态与使用方的 loading 任一为真；onClick 先于内置处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
okButtonProps.en-US: Props of the submit button. Without disabled, it is disabled while the value is empty; a disabled you give wins, which is how the custom type controls submission. It is loading when either the built-in pending state or your loading says so. onClick runs before the built-in handling, which still runs.

cancelButtonProps.zh-CN: 取消按钮的属性。loading 取内置的挂起态与使用方的 loading 任一为真；onClick 先于内置处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
cancelButtonProps.en-US: Props of the cancel button. It is loading when either the built-in pending state or your loading says so. onClick runs before the built-in handling, which still runs.

onOk.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮时调用，返回后清空已填写的值；返回 Promise 时按钮保持加载，fulfill 后才清空，reject 时保留。组件不会自行关闭，由使用方把 visible 设为 false。保留为函数 prop 以读取返回值，使用方照常写 @ok。
onOk.en-US: Called when the submit button is clicked; the filled-in value is cleared once it returns. A returned Promise keeps the button loading and the value is cleared only once it fulfills, and kept when it rejects. The component never closes itself on submit; the caller sets visible to false. It remains a function prop so its result can be read, bound with @ok as usual.

onCancel.zh-CN: 取消按钮、关闭按钮、Esc（modal 模式另有点击遮罩）触发；按 Esc 时参数为原生 KeyboardEvent。返回后清空已填写的值并更新 v-model:visible；返回 Promise 时取消按钮保持加载，fulfill 后才清空并更新，reject 时保持打开。保留为函数 prop 以读取返回值，使用方照常写 @cancel。
onCancel.en-US: Called by the cancel button, the close button, Esc and, in modal mode, a click on the mask; the argument is a native KeyboardEvent for Esc. Once it returns, the filled-in value is cleared and v-model:visible updates. A returned Promise keeps the cancel button loading; both happen only once it fulfills, and a rejection keeps the feedback open. It remains a function prop so its result can be read, bound with @cancel as usual.

update:visible.zh-CN: 取消路径（取消按钮、关闭按钮、Esc，modal 模式另有遮罩）完成后触发，值为 false，供 v-model:visible 回写。提交按钮只调用 onOk，不触发该事件。
update:visible.en-US: Emitted with false once a cancel path (cancel button, close button, Esc, and the mask in modal mode) completes, for v-model:visible to write back. The submit button only calls onOk and never emits this.

valueChange.zh-CN: 反馈内容变化时触发，载荷为当前值：text 为字符串，emoji 为 `{ emoji, text }`（text 是选了「差」后填写的原因），radio 为所选项的值，checkbox 为所选值的数组。
valueChange.en-US: Emitted when the feedback content changes. The payload is the current value: a string for text, `{ emoji, text }` for emoji (text is the reason filled in after choosing the bad face), the value of the chosen option for radio, and an array of chosen values for checkbox.

afterClose.zh-CN: 弹层完全关闭后触发，两种模式都会触发。
afterClose.en-US: Emitted after the panel has fully closed, in both modes.

afterVisibleChange.zh-CN: 显示状态变化且动画结束后触发，仅 popup 模式发出。
afterVisibleChange.en-US: Emitted once the shown state has changed and the animation has ended. Only popup mode emits it.

default.zh-CN: type 为 custom 时的反馈内容。

content.zh-CN: 包裹或替换内置内容，任何 type 都可用，参数 content 是内置内容的 VNode，用 `<component :is="content" />` 放置。
content.en-US: Wraps or replaces the built-in content for any type. The scope parameter content is the VNode of the built-in content; place it with `<component :is="content" />`.

title.zh-CN: 标题，优先于 title 属性。
title.en-US: Title. It wins over the title prop.

footer.zh-CN: 替换默认的取消、提交按钮。传入空插槽时不渲染页脚区域。
footer.en-US: Replaces the default cancel and submit buttons. An empty slot renders no footer area.

header.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：完全替换默认头部。
header.en-US: Modal mode only: replaces the whole default header.

icon.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：标题前的图标。
icon.en-US: Modal mode only: icon before the title.

modal.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：自定义渲染对话框本身，参数 modal 是 role=dialog 元素的 VNode，用 `<component :is="modal" />` 放置。
modal.en-US: Modal mode only: custom rendering of the dialog itself. The scope parameter modal is the VNode of the role=dialog element; place it with `<component :is="modal" />`.

radioLabel.zh-CN: 自定义 radioGroupProps.options 中每一项的文本，作用域参数为 option 与 index。
radioLabel.en-US: Custom label of each item in radioGroupProps.options, with the option and index scope parameters.

radioExtra.zh-CN: 自定义 radioGroupProps.options 中每一项的辅助文本，作用域参数为 option 与 index。
radioExtra.en-US: Custom extra text of each item in radioGroupProps.options, with the option and index scope parameters.

checkboxLabel.zh-CN: 自定义 checkboxGroupProps.options 中每一项的文本，作用域参数为 option 与 index。
checkboxLabel.en-US: Custom label of each item in checkboxGroupProps.options, with the option and index scope parameters.

checkboxExtra.zh-CN: 自定义 checkboxGroupProps.options 中每一项的辅助文本，作用域参数为 option 与 index。
checkboxExtra.en-US: Custom extra text of each item in checkboxGroupProps.options, with the option and index scope parameters.

root.zh-CN: Portal 内 Modal 或 SideSheet 的最外层元素，未渲染时为 null。
root.en-US: The outermost element of the Modal or SideSheet inside the portal, or null while nothing is rendered.
